title: Can’t find the family share “code” or link
body: I bought the subscription (for up to 5 people). I really like the app, but I can’t find how to share the paid app with my family members. Googled it, looked through everything on the app and Apple store, can not find the information about it.
author: Leila 🦊

title: Idea for improvement
body:
Nice app, but I would like to see on the home page the exact time I start doing the tasks. So if I planned to do it at 3 PM then I would like to see that information straight on the first page of the app. Also it would be perfect if the importance of tasks were automatically arranged according to the principle: the earlier I planned them, the higher the task is on the list.

Thank you.

title: Please remove some bugs
body: I have discovered some bugs while using the app. I have issues with ‘conatct friend’ habit / it wouldn’t appear in your list if you added it. And then there is some trouble with adding count/steps/ml etc for habit - sometimes it won’t appear even though you had added some results just now. But overall I enjoy the app every day.
